title: Sentinel Auth
content:
Sentinel is the official authentication and authorization orbit for Photon. It supports multiple guards (JWT, Session) and an Authorization Gate for permissions.

Setup

import { OrbitSentinel } from '@gravito/sentinel'

app.orbit(new OrbitSentinel({
  guards: {
    api: { driver: 'jwt', secret: process.env.JWT_SECRET }
  }
}))

Protecting Routes

Use the auth middleware to protect endpoints.

import { auth } from '@gravito/sentinel'

app.get('/profile', auth('api'), (c) => {
  const user = c.get('auth').user()
  return c.json({ user })
})

// Login and issue token
app.post('/login', async (c) => {
  const token = await c.get('auth').attempt(c.req.json())
  return c.json({ token })
})
